sections.label: CRLF header injection in an email field (add recipients)
Body injection (end header block, start body)
Address-parsing confusion (validator vs mail library disagree on the domain)
Local-part trick with the target domain as a sub-label of a controlled domain
Reset / invitation duplication (array or duplicated parameter: see HTTP-Parameter-Pollution)
HTML injection in HTML email (link or image to a controlled host)
SMTP command injection (webmail or mail proxy sending to a back end; in a field that becomes an SMTP command argument)
IMAP command injection (a mailbox name or message number placed into a command; marker commands only)
Mail header spoofing checks (SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment; send only to your own mailbox)
Open mail relay checks (run only against hosts you own)
